consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the second set of the show is a standout, particularly praising the Scarlet>Fire>Estimated>Eyes sequence as one of the highlights. While some reviewers noted sound quality issues, many felt that the band's performance was strong and engaging throughout.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 47 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the performance, there were notable criticisms regarding miscues and sound quality that tempered overall enthusiasm.
